subject: [RFC PATCH 5/7] mm/khugepaged: handle memory.high overage in MADV_COLLAPSE

2026-11-22.patch_summary: This patch addresses an issue where the MADV_COLLAPSE operation can lead to excessive memory usage, exceeding the 'memory.high' limit, by introducing a mechanism to throttle this overage immediately after collapsing pages in the khugepaged code. This ensures that even if the charge path is later modified to no longer enforce 'memory.high', the overage will still be handled promptly and within the expected limits.
